title: ChemInform Abstract: Crystal Structure and Chemical Bonding of Novel Li‐Containing Polar Intermetallic Compound La<sub>11</sub>Li<sub>12</sub>Ge<sub>16</sub>.
abstract: AbstractThe title compound is prepared from a stoichiometric mixture of the elements (Nb ampule, Ar, 1085 °C, 5 h) and characterized by powder and single crystal XRD.
